follow-up time: until delivery (average of 31 days after first amnioinfusion)
outcome: diagnosis accuracy of congenital fetal malformation
finding: While transabdominal amnioinfusion was found to be safe, perinatal and neonatal mortalities were high (45% and 35% respectively), likely due to the presence of major fetal malformations, the diagnosis of which was improved by the procedure.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at first treatment was 24 weeks
